issues: Shows 'No data available' empty state when no IST transfers exist - this is correct behavior

critical_code_review_comments: All 32 Replenishment Planner test cases PASS
Reorder Point formula correctly implements: RP = (Avg Daily Sales x Lead Time) + Safety Stock
High variability detection uses std dev > 0.5 * avg_daily_sales with z-score 1.65 for safety stock
Seasonal detection based on >50% sales in single quarter
New style detection based on first_sale_date < 30 days ago, uses category average ROS
Order Quantity formula: Order Qty = (Cover Days x Avg Sales) - Current Stock, min 0
MOQ and pack_size rounding applied before warehouse stock reduction
IST prioritizes same-region transfers for lower cost
Replenishment Run calculates pre/post metrics for stockout reduction, fill rate improvement, DOH improvement
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 5 tabs and controls verified working
